from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class PaperCitationData(BaseModel):
    """Information about one paper's citation relationships within the provided collection."""
    paper_title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper as it appears in the document")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other papers in the collection that this paper cites (based on its reference list)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[PaperCitationData]
